_description: Centralized error log for the Futuraria Design Harness. Every tool failure, API error, and unexpected result is recorded. PRIMARY STORE: Supabase (harness_error_logs table via MCP harness_report_error). FALLBACK: localStorage (futuraria-error-log) if Supabase is unreachable.

_rules.mandatory_reporting: When ANY tool call fails, the Leader MUST call harness_report_error with: tool name, arguments, error message, step index, round, and provider.
_rules.primary_store: Supabase table 'harness_error_logs' — persistent, queryable, multi-device. Inserted via MCP tool harness_report_error.
_rules.fallback_store: localStorage key 'futuraria-error-log' — used ONLY when Supabase/MCP is unreachable. Max 100 entries.
_rules.user_visible: Errors are also sent to the user via chat as structured summary messages.
_rules.internal_analysis: Query Supabase directly for error trends: SELECT tool, count(*) FROM harness_error_logs GROUP BY tool ORDER BY count DESC;
_rules.migration: Run supabase_migrations_v15.sql to create the harness_error_logs table.
